source: NCERT Class XII, Politics in India Since Independence, Ch. 8 (Recent Developments in Indian Politics).

sections.heading: 1. The Era of Coalitions
points: From 1989, India entered an **era of coalition governments** — the end of one-party (Congress) dominance.
The **1989 elections** saw the Congress lose; the **National Front (V.P. Singh)** formed a coalition government.
Multiple parties and alliances (NDA, UPA) came to define national politics.

sections.heading: 2. Mandal and Mandir
points: The **Mandal Commission** (implemented by V.P. Singh, 1990) recommended **reservations for Other Backward Classes (OBCs)** in government jobs → 'Mandal' politics; upheld by the Supreme Court (with conditions — the 'creamy layer').
The **Ram Janmabhoomi–Babri Masjid dispute (Ayodhya)** and the **demolition of the Babri Masjid (1992)** → communal tensions; the rise of the **BJP**.
These reshaped politics around **caste (OBC) and religion**.

sections.heading: 3. Economic Reforms and New Politics
points: The **economic reforms of 1991 (LPG)** shifted policy toward liberalisation — accepted by later governments across parties ('consensus').
Rise of **regional parties, backward-caste and Dalit parties (e.g. BSP, SP, RJD)**.
Coalition politics required **alliance-building and compromise** at the national level.

sections.heading: 4. Consensus and Continuity
points: Despite party competition, an emerging **consensus** on: **economic reforms, acceptance of regional parties, and the role of backward castes**, and **pragmatic ideology**.
Governments: **NDA (BJP-led, Vajpayee 1998–2004; later Modi), UPA (Congress-led, Manmohan Singh 2004–2014)**.
Indian democracy adapted to **coalition and competitive multi-party politics**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: From 1989 = era of coalition governments (end of Congress dominance).
Mandal Commission (implemented 1990) = OBC reservation (V.P. Singh).
Babri Masjid demolition = 1992 (Ayodhya); rise of the BJP.
Economic reforms (1991, LPG) accepted across parties.
Alliances: NDA (BJP-led), UPA (Congress-led).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **Mandal Commission recommended OBC reservation** (implemented by V.P. Singh, 1990).
The **Babri Masjid was demolished in 1992** (Ayodhya).
From **1989, coalition governments** became the norm.
The **1991 economic reforms (LPG)** became a broad political consensus.
